title: [SOA] Ignore item availability when disabled
summary: The Sales Order Agent now ignores item availability signals when availability checking is disabled in settings, while still requesting assistance when no item is found.
key_points: Adds prompt instruction to skip availability checks when feature is disabled
Excludes availability and capable-to-promise instructions from generated prompts when disabled
Hides and neutralizes availability values on the item search page for agent sessions when setting is off
Failed item searches still escalate to request assistance regardless of availability setting
quote: add a disabled-state prompt instruction that tells the agent to ignore item availability signals
